signal.units: dimensionless sample and amplitude; period=1; j=0..N-1; no PDE/no time evolution
signal.formula: u[j]=dc+nyquist*(-1)^j+sum_(k,A,phi) A*cos(2*pi*k*j/N+phi); energy-only fixture sets dc=nyquist=0 and uses exact mixed interior modes

DFT.method: independent O(N^2) summation using math.fsum; no FFT library
DFT.analytic_coefficients: DC=N*dc; Nyquist=N*nyquist; positive interior mode=N*A/2*exp(i*phase), negative=conjugate

energy_component.fixture: zero DC, no Nyquist, mixed three interior modes with actual amplitudes
energy_component.clean: PASS at original relative energy tolerance
energy_component.inflated: 1.5*u with unchanged actual reference amplitudes must FAIL; ideal relative residual=1.25
energy_component.original_component: load only reviewed fft and energy_budget functions; bind module N=fixture N locally

reference_separation.r2_historical: read frozen amplitude_guard_check.json; 4.090885079679787e-14 clean and 1.250000000000092 inflated are inherited evidence, not a new run
reference_separation.r1_guard: inspect original [1.0] reference and dynamically demonstrate on small-N fixture; do not rerun original 4096-field

acceptance: every clean coefficient/energy identity must pass and each named mutation must be rejected; summary rejects missing/failed checks; separate current component validation from inherited r1/r2 round verdicts
limitations: Finite deterministic periodic signals only; direct DFT is numerically independent of radix-2 algorithm but the author has read source (not a blinded verification); no physical novelty.

positive_exponent_conjugation.rejection: max absolute signed coefficient error >1e-10; Parseval alone cannot reject conjugation

inflated_reference_amplitudes_1_5.rejection: mutation's inflated negative-control detection must fail; validator must detect this failure

wrong_single_amplitude_reference.rejection: clean reference PASS must fail; do not count inflated-only rejection as a valid guard

execution_source_policy: compile only reviewed fft and energy_budget AST definitions from pinned sources with math and fixture-specific N; no original module top-level/main/make_field execution
runtime_errors: any exception/source/protocol hash failure must preserve stderr and produce nonzero status; no success result can be reused; missing named checks false
